name: @w6w-apps/freshsales
description: Manage Freshsales Suite contacts, accounts and deals.

w6w.longDescription:
Freshsales (Freshworks' CRM, marketed as "Freshsales Suite") covers the three objects a sales workflow moves between: contacts, accounts and deals can each be created, fetched, listed, updated and deleted, and a note can be logged against any of them to record what happened without a rep opening the CRM directly.

Listing is view-based rather than a flat scan — Freshsales has no plain "list everything" endpoint, so the list actions take a saved view id (a `view-get-many` action per resource fetches the account's own views, including the built-in "All Contacts"/"All Accounts"/"All Deals") and page through it.

A fit for routing an external event — a form submission, a support escalation, a signup — into a new lead-like contact or deal, updating a deal as it moves through its pipeline, or syncing contact and account data between Freshsales and another system.
